local function gripWorld(p110, p111, p112) -- Line: 337
    if not (p110 and p110.Parent) then
        return nil;
    end;

    local Parent = p110.Parent;

    if Parent == p111 then
        return (p112 * p110.CFrame).Position;
    end;

    for _, child in ipairs(Parent:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Weld") and (child.Part1 == Parent and child.Part0 == p111) then
            return (p112 * child.C0 * child.C1:Inverse() * p110.CFrame).Position;
        end;
    end;

    return p110.WorldPosition;
end;

local function solveArm(p113, p114, p115, p116, p117) -- Line: 350
    local joints = p113.joints;
    local v118 = joints[p114 .. "Shoulder"];
    local v119 = joints[p114 .. "Elbow"];
    local v120 = joints[p114 .. "Wrist"];
    local v121 = p113.arm[p114];
    local v122;

    if v118:IsA("Motor6D") or v118:IsA("Weld") then
        v122 = v118.C0;
    else

    end;

    local Position = v123.Position;
    local v124 = p116 - Position;

        return;

    local math_clamp_ret = math.clamp(Magnitude, v126, a + B - 0.02);
    local v127 = (a * a - B * B + math_clamp_ret * math_clamp_ret) / (math_clamp_ret * 2);

        v128 = p115.RightVector - v125 * p115.RightVector:Dot(v125);
    end;

    local Unit = v128.Unit;

    local v130 = Position + v125 * math_clamp_ret;
    local Unit2 = (Position - v129).Unit;
    local v131 = v130 - v129 - Unit2 * (v130 - v129):Dot(Unit2);

    if v131.Magnitude > 0.001 then
        Unit = -v131.Unit or Unit;
    end;

    local Unit3 = Unit2:Cross(Unit).Unit;
    local Unit4 = Unit3:Cross(Unit2).Unit;

        v132 = v118.C1;

    end;

    local v134;

        v134 = v119.C0;

    end;

    local function cardState(p231, p232) -- Line: 640

    end;
